name: Feature request

title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when I have to pull data out of Postgres to calculate [...]

**Describe the quantitative model/feature you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. If you are proposing a new quantitative model (e.g. a new risk metric, volatility estimator, or pricing model), please include standard mathematical definitions or references (like papers or standard textbooks).

**Proposed SQL Interface**
How would you expect this feature to look when writing SQL? 
```sql
-- Example proposed usage:
SELECT * FROM pgquant_new_model('SELECT ...');
```

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions (e.g. existing extensions, doing it in application code, pl/python, etc.).

**Additional context**
Add any other context or examples here.
